summary.text: Byron Callies is a Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives, District 5, and a former state representative who served from 2023 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Callies served in the U.S. military and reached the rank of lieutenant colonel.
His career experience includes working with the South Dakota Department of Energy.

Callies lost the 2018 Republican primary for the District 5 State Senate seat, then won election to the South Dakota House of Representatives from District 5 in 2022 and took office on January 10, 2023.
In the 2023–2024 session he served on the House Commerce and Energy, Education, and Military and Veterans' Affairs committees.
He lost the 2024 Republican primary and left office on January 14, 2025; the 2026 Republican primary for the seat was canceled.
